{"consolidated_memory":"CONSOLIDATED MEMORY: Broken Layout in notifications/email/render.py (Multiple Occasions)

Component: notifications/email/render.py (notifications side)
Recurring symptom across all occasions: Table overflows in plain text part of email renderer when rendering digest template with long subject

THREE SEPARATE OCCASIONS:

OCCASION 1: [2026-01-19]
- Trigger/environment: Traffic arriving through corporate proxy
- Root cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
- Fix: Moved arithmetic to integer minor units
- PR #1288, branch fix/broken-layout-1
- Outcome: Backlog cleared 4 minutes after deploy

OCCASION 2: [2026-03-23]
- Trigger/environment: Staging read replica only
- Root cause: Two writes that were never wrapped in a transaction
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction
- PR #6170, branch fix/broken-layout-2
- Stack: Python
- Covering test: tests/notifications/test_render.py
- Outcome: Job finished in 62 minutes instead of 9 hours

OCCASION 3: [2026-06-04]
- Trigger/environment: Deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: Config loader reading the wrong environment file
- Fix: Made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #7444, branch fix/broken-layout-3
- Stack: Python
- Covering test: tests/notifications/test_render.py
- Outcome: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 68 days running

NOTE: All three occasions involved the same file corner and similar symptoms but distinct root causes requiring separate fixes. Context for Occasion 1 carried over from earlier broken layout work in the same area."}
